items.title_en: ’32 slaps and nobody stepped in’: Baghpat gym fight caught on CCTV, escalates into street brawl
items.title_zh: “打了32个耳光，却没有人介入”：闭路电视拍摄到巴格帕特健身房打架事件，升级为街头斗殴
items.summary_en: The incident took place at a gym in Agarwal Mandi Tatiri, which falls under the jurisdiction of Baghpat Kotwali police station.
items.summary_zh: 事件发生在 Agarwal Mandi Tatiri 的一家健身房，该健身房隶属 Baghpat Kotwali 警察局管辖。

items.title_en: Skyscanner travel trends 2027: Top destinations and what Indians want
items.title_zh: Skyscanner 2027 年旅游趋势：热门目的地和印度人的需求
items.summary_en: Rupsi (Assam) ranked No.2 while Malvan (Maharashtra) ranked No. 4 in Skyscanner's top trending destinations for 2027. (Photo Credit wikimedia commons)
items.summary_zh: 在 Skyscanner 2027 年热门目的地中，Rupsi（阿萨姆邦）排名第二，而 Malvan（马哈拉施特拉邦）排名第四。（图片来源 wikimedia commons）

items.title_en: Smriti Irani remembers Nana Patekar; Anand Mahindra compares him to Marlon Brando
items.title_zh: 斯姆里蒂·伊拉尼 (Smriti Israeli) 记得娜娜·帕特卡 (Nana Patekar)；阿南德·马辛德拉将他比作马龙·白兰度
items.summary_en: While Irani shared intimate memories of their relationship, Mahindra described Patekar as an actor whose identity transcended his roles, making him a cultural touchstone.
items.summary_zh: 虽然伊拉尼分享了他们关系的亲密回忆，但马辛德拉将帕特卡描述为一名身份超越角色的演员，使他成为文化试金石。
